notes.title: Happy Ducking Birthday: Celebrating a Year of Arcade Adventures!
notes.content:
Marking the first anniversary of D.U.C.K. fills us with pride! It's been 365 days of endless fun and unpredictable adventures since the ducklings became the heroes of their games. We sincerely thank you, our players, for your invaluable support and constructive feedback, which have played a crucial role in bringing about positive changes to the game. Your input mostly inspired the upcoming update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620203/539861e24aef9be2f72e9deda797f11c64097421.gif

On this exceptionally special day, we are excited to announce that we’re partaking in the Steam Remote Play Together Fest! During this week you have a chance to SAVE 25% on the D.U.C.K. game and even 40% on the Bundle! This offer ends 19 February, 10 AM PT, so don’t miss it! It’s the perfect gift for anyone who appreciates the fun and is ready to dive into the arcades all night long!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620203/448aebcbbfecc4d388ef48073fe3b351cdd89e8e.jpg

The other great news is the major update we’re releasing tonight!

Within this release, we have intensified the challenge in some of your beloved micro-games, introducing new thrills, and streamlined mechanics in the tough ones. This patch is designed to elevate your gaming experience, offering a more immersive and captivating journey through the D.U.C.K. world. Are you ready to take up new challenges?

Seize the moment and join the ducklings in their adventures full of fun! Whether you do or don’t have a company for tonight, we know the best way to spend this evening — immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of childhood and retro video games. Let your Valentine's adventure begin right now!

notes.title: DUCK's soundtrack and update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, March 27, the soundtrack for "DUCK" is released. For now, you can purchase it separately, and a bundle "game + soundtrack" will be released a little later. Enjoy amazing retro music while playing the game and beyond!

We also made some changes and fixed bugs. For example, the level with the labyrinth now has increased visibility range.

Play DUCK, listen to good music and see you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336320/DUCK_Dangerous_Ultimate_Cartridge_Kidnapper_Soundtrack/
